patronOf.en-US: The faithful receive the Body of Christ
patronOf.pt-BR: Os fiéis recebem o Corpo de Cristo

meta.basis: The priest 'takes the paten or ciborium and approaches the communicants, who usually come up in procession'; he 'raises the host slightly and shows it to each, saying, The Body of Christ. The communicant replies, Amen' (GIRM 160–161; the Order of Mass rubric). In the US, Communion is received standing, the communicant bowing the head before the Sacrament, on the tongue or in the hand (GIRM 160); the Communion-plate is prepared 'for the Communion of the faithful' (GIRM 118c). Communion under the one kind, so no chalice ministers.
